t: OB21 Premium Shower & Bath Silicone is an acetic curing sealant, specifically formulated for reliable sealing around baths, basins, and sanitary ware in high humidity areas. This clear, 310ml silicone is ideal for professional plumbers and bathroom fitters, delivering a permanently elastic and durable seal. It provides exceptional water, UV, and weather resistance, making it suitable for both interior and exterior use. With effective mould and mildew-resistant properties, it ensures a long-lasting, hygienic finish up to 180°C, offering excellent protection against moisture and environmental factors.
b: For Use on Baths, Showers, Basins & Sanitaryware
